- [proved] The families are \(\{s_{22},s_{32},s_{42},s_{33},s_{43},s_{44}\}\) and \(\{s_{22},s_{221},s_{222},s_{2211},s_{2221},s_{2222}\}\). Each gives a surjection \(\mathbb Z^6\twoheadrightarrow Q\cong\mathbb Z^6\), hence an isomorphism; its quotient images are a basis, so no proper subfamily generates \(J\).
